readme.text: # @distube/ytdl-core YouTube video info and downloads for Node.js. A DisTube fork of [fent/node-ytdl-core](https://github.com/fent/node-ytdl-core). **[Documentation](https://distube.js.org/ytdl-core/)** · [Getting started](https://distube.js.org/ytdl-core/guides/getting-started/) · [API reference](https://distube.js.org/ytdl-core/api/readme/) ## Features - Video details, chapters, storyboards, related videos and every format - Caption tracks as WebVTT, JSON or XML text - Video and playlist search, playlists and channel uploads with every page, related videos and search suggestions - Node
downloads with byte ranges or a start time, and one format read many times through

- Downloads that resume on their own when YouTube cuts a URL off
- Live streams over HLS or DASH
- SABR-only formats, which on some clients means everything above 360p
- Signatures solved locally, no remote service
- Age-restricted videos with a cookie
- PO tokens minted in a worker thread with no setup, for the clients that need one
- Proxies through any

Requires Node.js 22.22.2+ on 22.x, 24.15.0+ on 24.x, or 26+, or Bun.

## Usage

Search, formats, live streams, clients, cookies, PO tokens, proxies and errors are covered in the [documentation](https://distube.js.org/ytdl-core/). Coming from 4.x? Read [Migrating from v4](https://distube.js.org/ytdl-core/guides/migrating-from-v4/).
